follow-up time: Until complete recovery or treatment failure
exposure: Uterine artery embolization (UAE) with subsequent dilatation and curettage (D&C)
cohort: 19 patients diagnosed with cesarean scar pregnancy
finding: Dilatation and curettage after uterine artery embolization resulted in a higher complete recovery rate (100% vs. 44%) and shorter hospital stay compared to methotrexate injection for the treatment of cesarean scar pregnancy.
